query: WITH pruned AS ( DELETE FROM noo_heartbeat_runs hr WHERE hr.started_at < NOW() - make_interval(days => $1) RETURNING hr.run_id, hr.task_id, to_jsonb(hr) AS payload ) INSERT INTO noo_heartbeat_run_prune_staging (run_id, task_id, payload, reason, prune_run_id) SELECT p.run_id, p.task_id, p.payload, $2, $3 FROM pruned p
